CrowdStrike NPM Packages Compromise (Shai-Hulud Worm)

Target: crowdstrike-npm
Repository: N/A
Date: 2025-09-14 to 2025-09-16 (2 days)
Attribution: Third Party
Component: Library
Language: JavaScript
Cause: Compromised Account/Credentials
Motive: Credential Theft
Transitive: false
Impact Type: Credential Theft/Self-Propagation
User Impact: 0
Domain: npmjs.com (package host)
Artifact Type: source archive
Insertion Phase: distribution

Synopsis

The Shai-Hulud self-propagating worm compromised over 526 npm packages, notably including several official @crowdstrike/ scoped packages. The malware hunts for GITHUB_TOKEN, NPM_TOKEN, and cloud credentials by executing TruffleHog. It actively propagates by hijacking publish rights to inject a malicious postinstall script and republishing affected packages.
